Read native-context.json, stdo_task.json and qualification-basis.md.
They identify the exact qualification subjects, presentation and grant.

Your real task is to produce an actionable Executive decision ledger and one
Reviewer handoff from the supplied work record. These are controlled fixture
observations, not live processes. Do not launch actors, wait for time to pass,
edit files, run construction tests, install, publish or adopt anything.
Read-only inspection and the selected Axiom pure joiner on stdout are allowed.

## Work and authority

Work item L7 corrects the Current link in draft/current.md to:
stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md

Its historical RC6 link must remain unchanged. Worker W authors only
draft/current.md. Historical release files and Git are outside W's grant.

The fixture owner grants Executive bounded coordination, read-only observation,
preparation of Worker/Reviewer requests, and disposition of L7 when all its
conditions hold. Product acceptance and release publication are not granted.

The owner requires author-independent review of the exact candidate before
L7 closes. A competent non-author Reviewer is available. All acting roles must
retain the capabilities required by their selected frames.

The owner also requires a write-set observation at milestone M, before further
Worker writes. Executive may direct an affected pause and obtain the missing
observation; it cannot expand the write territory.

## Exact candidate C1

```markdown
[Current](stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md)
[RC6](stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md)
```

## Exact candidate C2

```markdown
[Current][current]
[RC6](stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md)

[current]: stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md
```

C1 and C2 name these exact UTF-8/LF candidate contents, each with a terminal LF.
The inline-to-reference change is material to the link-rendering assessment.

E1 and E2 are separate passing mechanical rendering/link checks over C1 and C2
respectively, under the task's exact basis. Neither is independent assessment.
H0 is the separately recorded, still-valid observation that the historical
link is unchanged. Author judgments J1/J2 are self-review only.

## Work-record snapshots

Evaluate each snapshot independently. Do not import evidence from another row.
S5 is the current snapshot for the handoff you must prepare.

S0: W is performing its bounded grant. Completion notification is reliable.
No checkpoint is due, no exception is known, and no other authorized decision
is ready. Existing applicable judgments and H0 are unchanged.

S1: The owner asks, "Are we finished, and what happens next?" The available
work evidence is otherwise exactly S0.

S2: W returns candidate_ready for exact C1 with E1, H0 and J1, then stops.
The current checkpoint is verified as C1. No independent review is supplied.

S3: The declared return checkpoint has expired and completion notification is
unavailable. The result store contains no closed return. Worker status is
unknown; no observation establishes either progress or failure.

S4a: Notification remains reliable, but milestone M has arrived and its
required write-set observation is missing.

S4b: The bounded observation then reports that W's proposed next write targets
a historical release file outside its grant. That write has not occurred.

S5: A lawful later Worker activation produced exact C2 and returned
candidate_ready with current E2, H0 and J2. The current workspace is verified
as C2. The only independent review available is R1, whose exact subject is C1
and whose rendering assessment is invalidated by the material markup change.
No independent C2 review is supplied.

S6: Two closed incomplete Worker returns repeat the same unresolved rendering
evidence gap on the same candidate/basis, without new decision-relevant evidence.
No new permission or resolving observation accompanies the second return.

S7: Exact C2 is current. E2 and H0 remain valid. A closed author-independent
review R2 is supplied: activation review-C2; reviewer R-other, not W; exact
subject C2 and this task's basis; claim Current-link correctness and historical
preservation; independently acquired candidate/source and E2/H0 evidence;
result satisfied; no findings or residuals; return to Executive.
All other L7 conditions are satisfied, with no material counterevidence.

## Required output

Return one JSON object with:

- delivery_decision: the next warranted Executive decision for every snapshot,
  its evidence basis, and what remains unresolved;
- evidence_disposition: retained, invalidated and still-required evidence,
  plus the source routes actually read;
- qualification_sequence: the bounded remaining path from current S5, without
  claiming that future actions or review have occurred;
- selected_frames: each selected frame URI, task-specific purpose and source route;
- handoff_sections: your own ordered label/text array preparing only the
  author-independent Reviewer request for S5/C2;
- joined_request: the exact selected Axiom joiner stdout for that array.

Use the seven-section handoff order: Role and outcome; Reference frame and exact
subject; Hard constraints; Index context and evidence routes; Open solution
space; Return and stop contract; ACTION.

The handoff must be usable from these exact candidate/evidence routes, preserve
Reviewer independence and read-only scope, and return one closed result to
Executive. Do not send it.

Invoke the exact selected joiner with --input /dev/stdin and omit --output.
Return actual tool status. Do not invent missing source, map, frame or evidence
bindings.

56	URI_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:[A-Za-z0-9._~:/?#\[\]@!$&'()*+,;=%-]+$")
57	
58	
59	class DuplicateKeyError(ValueError):
60	    pass
61	
62	
63	def unique_pairs(pairs: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
64	    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
65	    for key, value in pairs:
66	        if key in result:
67	            raise DuplicateKeyError(key)
68	        result[key] = value
69	    return result

71	
72	def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
73	    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=unique_pairs)
74	
75	
76	def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
77	    return json.dumps(
78	        value,
79	        ensure_ascii=False,
80	        allow_nan=False,
81	        separators=(",", ":"),
82	        sort_keys=True,
83	    ).encode("utf-8")
84	
85	
86	def sha256(data: bytes) -> str:
87	    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
88	
89	
90	def is_uri(value: Any) -> bool:
91	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not URI_RE.fullmatch(value):
92	        return False
93	    if re.search(r"%(?![0-9A-Fa-f]{2})", value):
94	        return False
95	    parsed = urlparse(value)
96	    if not parsed.scheme:
97	        return False
98	    remainder = value[len(parsed.scheme) + 1 :]
99	    return not remainder.startswith("//") or bool(parsed.netloc)
100	
101	
102	def diagnostic(
103	    issues: list[dict[str, str]],
104	    code: str,
105	    record: str,
106	    field: str,
107	    ref: str | None = None,
108	) -> None:
109	    row = {"code": code, "record": record, "field": field}

115	def heading_slugs(text: str) -> set[str]:
116	    slugs: set[str] = set()
117	    occurrences: dict[str, int] = {}
118	    for line in text.splitlines():
119	        match = re.match(r"^#{1,6}\s+(.+?)\s*#*\s*$", line)
120	        if not match:
121	            continue
122	        base = match.group(1).strip().lower()
123	        base = re.sub(r"[^\w\- ]", "", base, flags=re.UNICODE)
124	        base = re.sub(r"[\s\-]+", "-", base).strip("-")
125	        count = occurrences.get(base, 0)
126	        occurrences[base] = count + 1
127	        slugs.add(base if count == 0 else f"{base}-{count}")
128	    return slugs

131	class Resolver:
132	    def __init__(self, binding_path: Path, value: Any):
133	        if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {
134	            "kind",

141	        rows = value["bindings"]
142	        if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
143	            raise ValueError("empty_binding_set")
144	        seen: set[str] = set()
145	        self.bindings: list[tuple[str, Path]] = []
146	        self.protected_paths: set[Path] = set()
147	        self.protection_complete = True
148	        for row in rows:

152	            physical = row["path"]
153	            if not is_uri(prefix) or not isinstance(physical, str) or not physical:
154	                raise ValueError("invalid_binding_coordinate")
155	            if prefix in seen:

158	            root = Path(physical)

162	        self.bindings.sort(key=lambda pair: len(pair[0]), reverse=True)
163	
164	    def resolve(self, uri: str) -> tuple[Path, str | None]:
165	        base_uri, fragment = urldefrag(uri)
166	        matches = [
167	            (prefix, root)
168	            for prefix, root in self.bindings
169	            if base_uri.startswith(prefix)
170	        ]
171	        if not matches:
172	            raise ValueError("unresolved_uri")
173	        longest = len(matches[0][0])
174	        matches = [row for row in matches if len(row[0]) == longest]
175	        if len(matches) != 1:
176	            raise ValueError("ambiguous_uri")
177	        prefix, root = matches[0]
178	        relative = unquote(base_uri[len(prefix) :]).lstrip("/")
179	        try:
180	            target = (root / relative).resolve()
181	            # Non-strict resolve no longer raises for symlink loops on Python
182	            # 3.13. Keep an unresolved target from permitting output cleanup.
183	            try:
184	                target.stat()
185	            except OSError as exc:
186	                if exc.errno == errno.ELOOP:
187	                    raise
188	        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
189	            self.protection_complete = False
190	            raise
191	        # Protect a known attempted source even when its binding must refuse.
192	        # This records identity only; it does not admit or read escaped bytes.
193	        self.protected_paths.add(target)
194	        try:
195	            target.relative_to(root)
196	        except ValueError as exc:
197	            raise ValueError("binding_escape") from exc
198	        if not target.exists():
199	            raise ValueError("missing_resource")
200	        if fragment:
201	            if not target.is_file() or target.suffix.lower() not in {
202	                ".md",
203	                ".markdown",
204	            }:
205	                raise ValueError("unsupported_fragment")
206	            if fragment not in heading_slugs(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
207	                raise ValueError("unresolved_fragment")
208	        return target, fragment or None
209	
210	    def resolve_file(self, uri: str) -> tuple[Path, str | None]:
211	        target, fragment = self.resolve(uri)
212	        if not target.is_file():
213	            raise ValueError("resource_not_file")
214	        return target, fragment

217	def exact_keys(
218	    value: Any,
219	    expected: set[str],
220	    issues: list[dict[str, str]],
221	    record: str,
222	    field: str,
223	) -> bool:
224	    if not isinstance(value, dict):
225	        diagnostic(issues, "wrong_shape", record, field)
226	        return False
227	    missing = sorted(expected - set(value))
228	    extra = sorted(set(value) - expected)
229	    for key in missing:
230	        diagnostic(issues, "missing_field", record, f"{field}.{key}")
231	    for key in extra:
232	        diagnostic(issues, "unknown_field", record, f"{field}.{key}")
233	    return not missing and not extra

239	    record: str,
240	    field: str,
241	    *,
242	    nonempty: bool = False,
243	) -> list[str]:
244	    if not isinstance(value, list):
245	        diagnostic(issues, "wrong_shape", record, field)
246	        return []
247	    if nonempty and not value:
248	        diagnostic(issues, "empty_set", record, field)
249	    valid: list[str] = []
250	    for ref in value:
251	        if not is_uri(ref):
252	            diagnostic(issues, "invalid_uri", record, field, str(ref))
253	        else:
254	            valid.append(ref)
255	    if len(valid) != len(set(valid)):
256	        diagnostic(issues, "duplicate_ref", record, field)
257	    if valid != sorted(valid):
258	        diagnostic(issues, "noncanonical_order", record, field)
259	    return valid

262	def validate_program(program: Any, resolver: Resolver) -> dict[str, Any]:
263	    issues: list[dict[str, str]] = []
264	    root = (
265	        program.get("uri", "urn:axiom-indexer:diagnostic:program")
266	        if isinstance(program, dict)
267	        else "urn:axiom-indexer:diagnostic:program"
268	    )
269	    indexed = isinstance(program, dict) and "frame_indexes" in program
270	    keys = TOP_KEYS | {"frame_indexes"} if indexed else TOP_KEYS
271	    if not exact_keys(program, keys, issues, root, "$program"):
272	        return report(program, issues, {})
273	    if program["kind"] != "axiom-indexer.axiomatic-program":
274	        diagnostic(issues, "wrong_kind", root, "kind")
275	    if program["schema_version"] != 1:
276	        diagnostic(issues, "wrong_schema_version", root, "schema_version")
277	    if not is_uri(program["uri"]):
278	        diagnostic(issues, "invalid_uri", root, "uri", str(program["uri"]))
279	    resolved_sources: dict[str, str] = {}
280	    if not is_uri(program["calculus_ref"]):
281	        diagnostic(
282	            issues,
283	            "invalid_uri",
284	            root,
285	            "calculus_ref",
286	            str(program["calculus_ref"]),
287	        )
288	    else:
289	        try:
290	            path, _ = resolver.resolve_file(program["calculus_ref"])
291	            resolved_sources[program["calculus_ref"]] = sha256(path.read_bytes())
292	        except ValueError as exc:
293	            diagnostic(issues, str(exc), root, "calculus_ref", program["calculus_ref"])
294	    if not is_uri(program["source_basis"]):
295	        diagnostic(
296	            issues, "invalid_uri", root, "source_basis", str(program["source_basis"])
297	        )
298	    else:
299	        try:
300	            resolver.resolve(program["source_basis"])
301	        except ValueError as exc:
302	            diagnostic(issues, str(exc), root, "source_basis", program["source_basis"])
303	
304	    frames = uri_list(program["frame_refs"], issues, root, "frame_refs")
305	    vocabulary = uri_list(program["vocabulary_refs"], issues, root, "vocabulary_refs")
306	    for frame in frames:
307	        try:
308	            path, _ = resolver.resolve_file(frame)
309	            resolved_sources[frame] = sha256(path.read_bytes())
310	        except ValueError as exc:
311	            diagnostic(issues, str(exc), root, "frame_refs", frame)
312	
313	    item_lists = {
314	        "symbols": program["symbols"],
315	        "clauses": program["clauses"],
316	        "residuals": program["residuals"],
317	    }
318	    items: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
319	    for field, rows in item_lists.items():
320	        if not isinstance(rows, list):
321	            diagnostic(issues, "wrong_shape", root, field)
322	            item_lists[field] = []
323	            continue
324	        uris = [
325	            row.get("uri")
326	            for row in rows
327	            if isinstance(row, dict) and is_uri(row.get("uri"))
328	        ]
329	        if uris != sorted(uris):
330	            diagnostic(issues, "noncanonical_order", root, field)
331	        for row in rows:
332	            if not isinstance(row, dict) or not is_uri(row.get("uri")):
333	                diagnostic(issues, "invalid_item_uri", root, field)
334	                continue
335	            uri = row["uri"]
336	            if uri in items:
337	                diagnostic(issues, "duplicate_identity", uri, "uri", uri)
338	            else:
339	                items[uri] = row
340	
341	    def source_refs(row: dict[str, Any], record: str) -> None:
342	        refs = uri_list(
343	            row.get("source_refs"), issues, record, "source_refs", nonempty=True
344	        )
345	        for ref in refs:
346	            if is_uri(program["source_basis"]) and not ref.startswith(
347	                program["source_basis"]
348	            ):
349	                diagnostic(issues, "source_outside_basis", record, "source_refs", ref)
350	                continue
351	            try:
352	                path, _ = resolver.resolve_file(ref)
353	                resolved_sources[ref] = sha256(path.read_bytes())
354	            except ValueError as exc:
355	                diagnostic(issues, str(exc), record, "source_refs", ref)
356	
357	    for row in item_lists["symbols"]:
358	        if not isinstance(row, dict):
359	            continue
360	        record = row.get("uri", root)
361	        if not exact_keys(row, SYMBOL_KEYS, issues, record, "symbol"):
362	            continue
363	        if not is_uri(row["uri"]):
364	            diagnostic(issues, "invalid_uri", record, "uri", str(row["uri"]))
365	        if row["kind"] not in vocabulary:
366	            diagnostic(
367	                issues, "undeclared_vocabulary", record, "kind", str(row["kind"])
368	            )
369	        if not isinstance(row["label"], str) or not row["label"].strip():
370	            diagnostic(issues, "empty_label", record, "label")
371	        source_refs(row, record)
372	
373	    local_ids = set(items)
374	    external_ids = set(frames) | set(vocabulary)
375	    for row in item_lists["clauses"]:
376	        if not isinstance(row, dict):
377	            continue
378	        record = row.get("uri", root)
379	        if not exact_keys(row, CLAUSE_KEYS, issues, record, "clause"):
380	            continue
381	        if row["clause_type"] not in CLAUSE_TYPES:
382	            diagnostic(issues, "invalid_clause_type", record, "clause_type")
383	        if row["operator"] not in vocabulary:
384	            diagnostic(
385	                issues,
386	                "undeclared_vocabulary",
387	                record,
388	                "operator",
389	                str(row["operator"]),
390	            )
391	        if not isinstance(row["statement"], str) or not row["statement"].strip():
392	            diagnostic(issues, "empty_statement", record, "statement")
393	        arguments = row["arguments"]
394	        if not isinstance(arguments, list) or not arguments:
395	            diagnostic(issues, "empty_arguments", record, "arguments")
396	        else:
397	            for argument in arguments:
398	                if not isinstance(argument, dict):
399	                    diagnostic(issues, "wrong_shape", record, "arguments")
400	                    continue
401	                for key in sorted(set(argument) - ARGUMENT_KEYS):
402	                    diagnostic(issues, "unknown_field", record, f"arguments.{key}")
403	                if "role" not in argument:
404	                    diagnostic(issues, "missing_field", record, "arguments.role")
405	                    continue
406	                role = argument.get("role")
407	                if role not in vocabulary:
408	                    diagnostic(
409	                        issues,
410	                        "undeclared_vocabulary",
411	                        record,
412	                        "arguments.role",
413	                        str(role),
414	                    )
415	                has_ref = "ref" in argument
416	                has_literal = "literal" in argument
417	                if has_ref == has_literal:
418	                    diagnostic(issues, "invalid_argument_value", record, "arguments")
419	                elif has_ref:
420	                    ref = argument["ref"]
421	                    if not is_uri(ref):
422	                        diagnostic(
423	                            issues, "invalid_uri", record, "arguments.ref", str(ref)
424	                        )
425	                    elif ref not in local_ids and ref not in external_ids:
426	                        diagnostic(issues, "dangling_ref", record, "arguments.ref", ref)
427	                elif (
428	                    not isinstance(argument["literal"], (str, int, float, bool))
429	                    and argument["literal"] is not None
430	                ):
431	                    diagnostic(
432	                        issues, "invalid_argument_value", record, "arguments.literal"
433	                    )
434	        source_refs(row, record)
435	
436	    for row in item_lists["residuals"]:
437	        if not isinstance(row, dict):
438	            continue
439	        record = row.get("uri", root)
440	        if not exact_keys(row, RESIDUAL_KEYS, issues, record, "residual"):
441	            continue
442	        if row["kind"] not in RESIDUAL_KINDS:
443	            diagnostic(issues, "invalid_residual_kind", record, "kind")
444	        if not isinstance(row["detail"], str) or not row["detail"].strip():
445	            diagnostic(issues, "empty_detail", record, "detail")
446	        for ref in uri_list(row["subject_refs"], issues, record, "subject_refs"):
447	            if ref not in local_ids:
448	                diagnostic(issues, "dangling_ref", record, "subject_refs", ref)
449	        for ref in uri_list(
450	            row["re_entry_refs"], issues, record, "re_entry_refs", nonempty=True
451	        ):
452	            if ref in frames:
453	                continue
454	            try:
455	                path, _ = resolver.resolve_file(ref)
456	                if indexed:
457	                    resolved_sources[ref] = sha256(path.read_bytes())
458	            except ValueError as exc:
459	                diagnostic(issues, str(exc), record, "re_entry_refs", ref)
460	        source_refs(row, record)
461	
462	    if indexed:
463	        rows = program["frame_indexes"]
464	        if not isinstance(rows, list):
465	            diagnostic(issues, "wrong_shape", root, "frame_indexes")
466	            rows = []
467	        index_ids = [
468	            row["uri"] for row in rows
469	            if isinstance(row, dict) and is_uri(row.get("uri"))
470	        ]
471	        if index_ids != sorted(index_ids):
472	            diagnostic(issues, "noncanonical_order", root, "frame_indexes")
473	        claimed = local_ids | external_ids
474	        if is_uri(program["uri"]):
475	            claimed.add(program["uri"])
476	        family_ids = {
477	            family: {
478	                row["uri"] for row in item_lists[family]
479	                if isinstance(row, dict) and is_uri(row.get("uri"))
480	            }
481	            for family in ("clauses", "residuals")
482	        }
483	        for row in rows:
484	            record = row["uri"] if isinstance(row, dict) and is_uri(row.get("uri")) else root
485	            if not exact_keys(row, FRAME_INDEX_KEYS, issues, record, "frame_index"):
486	                continue
487	            if not is_uri(row["uri"]):
488	                diagnostic(issues, "invalid_uri", root, "frame_indexes.uri", str(row["uri"]))
489	            elif row["uri"] in claimed:
490	                diagnostic(issues, "duplicate_identity", record, "uri", row["uri"])
491	            else:
492	                claimed.add(row["uri"])
493	            if row["frame_ref"] not in frames:
494	                diagnostic(issues, "undeclared_frame", record, "frame_ref", str(row["frame_ref"]))
495	            if not isinstance(row["scope"], str) or not row["scope"].strip():
496	                diagnostic(issues, "empty_scope", record, "scope")
497	            roots: list[str] = []
498	            for field, family in (("clause_refs", "clauses"), ("residual_refs", "residuals")):
499	                refs = uri_list(row[field], issues, record, field)
500	                roots.extend(refs)
501	                for ref in refs:
502	                    if ref not in family_ids[family]:
503	                        code = "wrong_ref_kind" if ref in claimed else "dangling_ref"
504	                        diagnostic(issues, code, record, field, ref)
505	            if not roots:
506	                diagnostic(issues, "empty_selection", record, "frame_index")
507	            source_refs(row, record)
508	
509	    return report(program, issues, resolved_sources)

518	        )
519	    )
520	    safe_program = program if isinstance(program, dict) else {}
521	    try:
522	        digest = sha256(canonical_bytes(program))
523	    except (TypeError, ValueError, UnicodeEncodeError):
524	        digest = "unavailable"
525	        diagnostic(

531	        issues.sort(
532	            key=lambda row: tuple(

534	            )
535	        )
536	    return {
537	        "kind": "axiom-indexer.validation-report",
538	        "schema_version": 1,
539	        "status": "valid" if not issues else "invalid",
540	        "program_uri": safe_program.get("uri"),
541	        "program_sha256": digest,
542	        "resolved_sources": [
543	            {"uri": uri, "sha256": resolved_sources[uri]}
544	            for uri in sorted(resolved_sources)
545	        ],
546	        "derived_counts": {
547	            key: len(safe_program.get(key, []))
548	            if isinstance(safe_program.get(key), list)
549	            else 0
550	            for key in ("symbols", "clauses", "residuals")
551	        },
552	        "diagnostics": issues,
553	    }

556	def instantiate(program: dict[str, Any], validation: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
557	    outgoing: dict[str, list[str]] = {
558	        row["uri"]: []
559	        for family in ("symbols", "clauses", "residuals")
560	        for row in program[family]
561	    }
562	    for clause in program["clauses"]:
563	        for argument in clause["arguments"]:
564	            ref = argument.get("ref")
565	            if ref in outgoing:
566	                outgoing[ref].append(clause["uri"])
567	    for refs in outgoing.values():
568	        refs.sort()
569	    result = {
570	        "kind": "axiom-indexer.logical-constraint-map",
571	        "schema_version": 1,
572	        "program_uri": program["uri"],
573	        "program_sha256": validation["program_sha256"],
574	        "calculus_ref": program["calculus_ref"],
575	        "source_basis": program["source_basis"],
576	        "frame_refs": program["frame_refs"],
577	        "vocabulary_refs": program["vocabulary_refs"],
578	        "resolved_sources": validation["resolved_sources"],
579	        "symbols": {
580	            row["uri"]: {"kind": row["kind"], "label": row["label"]}
581	            for row in program["symbols"]
582	        },
583	        "clauses": program["clauses"],
584	        "constraints": [
585	            row["uri"]
586	            for row in program["clauses"]
587	            if row["clause_type"] == "constraint"
588	        ],
589	        "outgoing_clause_refs": outgoing,
590	        "residuals": program["residuals"],
591	        "source_routes": {
592	            row["uri"]: row["source_refs"]
593	            for family in ("symbols", "clauses", "residuals")
594	            for row in program[family]
595	        },
596	    }
597	    if "frame_indexes" in program:
598	        result["frame_indexes"] = {
599	            row["uri"]: row for row in program["frame_indexes"]
600	        }
601	    result["map_sha256"] = sha256(canonical_bytes(result))
602	    return result

605	def reference_closure(program: dict[str, Any], indexes: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
606	    """Close explicit local references and affected residuals, without interpreting roles."""
607	    families = {
608	        row["uri"]: family
609	        for family in ("symbols", "clauses", "residuals")
610	        for row in program[family]
611	    }
612	    items = {
613	        row["uri"]: row
614	        for family in ("symbols", "clauses", "residuals")
615	        for row in program[family]
616	    }
617	    affected: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
618	    for residual in program["residuals"]:
619	        for subject in residual["subject_refs"]:
620	            affected.setdefault(subject, []).append(residual["uri"])
621	    pending = [ref for row in indexes for field in ("clause_refs", "residual_refs") for ref in row[field]]
622	    included: set[str] = set()
623	    while pending:
624	        uri = pending.pop()
625	        if uri in included:
626	            continue
627	        included.add(uri)
628	        item = items[uri]
629	        if families[uri] == "clauses":
630	            pending.extend(arg["ref"] for arg in item["arguments"] if arg.get("ref") in items)
631	        elif families[uri] == "residuals":
632	            pending.extend(item["subject_refs"])
633	        pending.extend(affected.get(uri, []))
634	    return {
635	        family: sorted(uri for uri in included if families[uri] == family)
636	        for family in ("symbols", "clauses", "residuals")
637	    }

642	    return {
643	        "kind": "axiom-indexer.projection-report",
644	        "schema_version": 1,
645	        "status": "invalid" if issues else "valid",
646	        "program_uri": program.get("uri") if isinstance(program, dict) else None,
647	        "map_sha256": logical_map.get("map_sha256") if isinstance(logical_map, dict) else None,

653	def project_program(
654	    program: Any,
655	    logical_map: Any,
656	    resolver: Resolver,
657	    index_refs: Any,
658	    mode: Any,
659	) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any] | None]:
660	    validation = validate_program(program, resolver)
661	    issues = list(validation["diagnostics"])
662	    root = validation["program_uri"] or "urn:axiom-indexer:diagnostic:program"
663	    selected: list[str] = []
664	    if not isinstance(mode, str) or mode not in PROJECTION_MODES:
665	        diagnostic(issues, "invalid_projection_mode", root, "mode", str(mode))
666	    if not isinstance(index_refs, list) or not index_refs:
667	        diagnostic(issues, "empty_selection", root, "frame_index_refs")
668	    else:
669	        for ref in index_refs:
670	            if not is_uri(ref):
671	                diagnostic(issues, "invalid_uri", root, "frame_index_refs", str(ref))
672	            elif ref in selected:
673	                diagnostic(issues, "duplicate_selection", root, "frame_index_refs", ref)
674	            else:
675	                selected.append(ref)
676	    if validation["status"] != "valid":
677	        return projection_report(program, logical_map, selected, issues), None
678	    indexes = {row["uri"]: row for row in program.get("frame_indexes", [])}
679	    other_ids = {row["uri"] for family in ("symbols", "clauses", "residuals") for row in program[family]}
680	    other_ids.update(program["frame_refs"])
681	    other_ids.update(program["vocabulary_refs"])
682	    other_ids.add(program["uri"])
683	    for ref in selected:
684	        if ref not in indexes:
685	            code = "wrong_selection_kind" if ref in other_ids else "unknown_frame_index"
686	            diagnostic(issues, code, root, "frame_index_refs", ref)
687	    expected = instantiate(program, validation)
688	    try:
689	        same_map = canonical_bytes(logical_map) == canonical_bytes(expected)
690	    except (ValueError, TypeError, UnicodeEncodeError):
691	        same_map = False
692	    if not same_map:
693	        diagnostic(issues, "map_mismatch", root, "map")
694	        if isinstance(logical_map, dict) and logical_map.get("resolved_sources") != validation["resolved_sources"]:
695	            diagnostic(issues, "source_observation_mismatch", root, "map.resolved_sources")
696	    if issues:
697	        return projection_report(program, logical_map, selected, issues), None
698	
699	    chosen = [indexes[uri] for uri in sorted(selected)]
700	    closure = reference_closure(program, chosen)
701	    rows = {
702	        family: [row for row in program[family] if row["uri"] in closure[family]]
703	        for family in closure
704	    }
705	    frames = {row["frame_ref"] for row in chosen}
706	    vocabulary = {row["kind"] for row in rows["symbols"]}
707	    sources = {program["calculus_ref"]}
708	    for row in chosen:
709	        sources.update(row["source_refs"])
710	    for family_rows in rows.values():
711	        for row in family_rows:
712	            sources.update(row["source_refs"])
713	    for row in rows["clauses"]:
714	        vocabulary.add(row["operator"])
715	        for arg in row["arguments"]:
716	            vocabulary.add(arg["role"])
717	            if arg.get("ref") in program["vocabulary_refs"]:
718	                vocabulary.add(arg["ref"])
719	            if arg.get("ref") in program["frame_refs"]:
720	                frames.add(arg["ref"])
721	    for row in rows["residuals"]:
722	        sources.update(row["re_entry_refs"])
723	        frames.update(ref for ref in row["re_entry_refs"] if ref in program["frame_refs"])
724	    sources.update(frames)
725	    result = {

input.description: Print closure clause statements and list candidate supporting clauses

content.content:
### engagement-return-topology
statement: For the coordinated branch, Executive locks outcome/basis, selects the smallest dependency-ready frontier, consumes closed results and assigns priority, boundary effect, disposition and next action only within its existing authority. Reviewer returns technical evidence/triage without repair or decision authority. Direct Writer work instead returns to its declared work authority or existing result carrier under the same result algebra and operation/decision separation; Executive handoff is not a universal prerequisite.
  [subject] -> symbol:executive
  [subject] -> symbol:worker
  source_refs: ['stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#complete-engagement-transition', 'stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#engagement-applicability']

### executive-bounded-fallback-observation
statement: When notification is unavailable or unreliable, or an actual supervision obligation requires observation, use bounded fallback observation with a declared purpose, cadence or checkpoint, evidence target and stop/escalation condition. Silence proves neither progress nor failure; unknown status alone does not establish a stalled Worker. Investigate a genuine blocker or material risk and intervene when required within existing grants. Reliable notification does not waive an actual supervision duty, and observation or intervention cannot widen write territory or other authority.
  [subject] -> symbol:executive
  [support] -> clause:engagement-return-topology
  [support] -> clause:executive-mutation-needs-prior-writer-transition
  source_refs: ['stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#event-driven-executive-attention', 'stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#executive-drift-locks']

### executive-no-progress-reassessment
statement: Repeated no-progress observations or returns without new decision-relevant evidence require bounded reassessment of the frame, grant, dependency or evidence gap and a decision under existing authority. Do not continue polling or repeat the same repair on an unchanged basis. Reduced reasoning churn neither lowers assurance nor permits reduced required actor capability, and introduces no universal cost, budget or accounting gate.
  [subject] -> symbol:executive
  [support] -> clause:engagement-return-topology
  [support] -> clause:closed-result-reuse-preserves-required-independence
  [support] -> clause:required-frame-conjunction-retains-every-constraint
  source_refs: ['stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#event-driven-executive-attention', 'stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#executive-drift-locks']

### computed-result-reuse-invalidates-affected-dependencies
statement: After checking exact applicability, reuse valid C across roles, conversations and resumptions. Changed request, candidate, basis, owner/root, projection, accepted trace, rule, configuration or material evidence invalidates affected claims before reliance. Retain predecessor/successor identities, changed inputs, surviving facts and affected J dependencies; recompute the wider frontier where independence is unproved.
  [subject] -> symbol:computed-classification
  [subject] -> symbol:residual-judgment
  source_refs: ['stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment']

### closed-result-reuse-preserves-required-independence
statement: Reuse an unchanged closed result only after checking exact applicability. A material input change or declared revising observation invalidates the affected result before reliance, preserving predecessor/successor and demonstrably independent survivors. Required independent evaluations may share valid mechanical evidence but still acquire sufficient exact evidence and supply their own judgment under the actual independence conditions.
  [subject] -> symbol:closed-frame-result
  [subject] -> symbol:reference-frame
  [subject] -> symbol:residual-judgment
  source_refs: ['stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#return-a-closed-result', 'stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/TICKET_METHOD.md#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity']

### executive-mutation-needs-prior-writer-transition
statement: Executive performs no candidate, Product, worktree or implementation mutation. Before effects, the actor explicitly records a separate Worker/Writer activation with exact grant, subject and write territory. Tool access, small/reversible/test-only edits, later recording or later delegation cannot supply or retroactively authorize that transition; changing role supplies no independent assessment.
  [subject] -> symbol:executive
  [subject] -> symbol:worker
  source_refs: ['stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#executive-attention-evaluation-and-action']

### required-frame-conjunction-retains-every-constraint
statement: Under the declared conjunction rule, every mandatory constraint must be satisfied with valid applicable evidence. Absent, stale, wrong-subject/basis, incapable, conflicted or indeterminate required results cannot establish dependent satisfaction. Agreement cannot discard a material constraint/counterexample found by one contributor, and a caller-selected list does not establish that every owning obligation was included.
  [subject] -> symbol:frame-applicability
  [subject] -> symbol:closed-frame-result
  [subject] -> symbol:work-outcome
  [condition] -> clause:frame-applicability-preserves-true-false-and-unknown
  [support] -> clause:computed-facts-judgments-and-rulings-retain-owners
  [exception] -> clause:unknown-treatment-bounds-dependent-effects
  source_refs: ['stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#applicability-and-required-results', 'stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#result-conjunction', 'stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment', 'stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/TICKET_METHOD.md#condition-based-closure-and-reuse', 'stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/TICKET_METHOD.md#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity']

### frame-applicability-preserves-true-false-and-unknown
statement: Owning evaluation/scope predicates select obligations for the exact subject. True requires its evaluation and exact result; false excludes only that obligation under cited authority. Missing or ambiguous premises leave applicability unknown, never false. Available tools, frame names or families activate nothing by themselves; residual semantic applicability remains supported J.
  [subject] -> symbol:frame-applicability
  [subject] -> symbol:reference-frame
  [subject] -> symbol:closed-frame-result
  source_refs: ['stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.7/standards/REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#applicability-and-required-results']

### judgment-revision-is-scoped-and-does-not-invent-rulings
statement: Changed material evidence, basis or the revising observation causes affected reassessment with original/successor continuity. Preserve unrelated conclusions only where independence is supported. Reusing the author J cannot satisfy required independent assessment; recording or reusing J does not supply O, admission, acceptance, effects or continuation.
  [subject] -> symbol:residual-judgment
  [subject] -> symbol:owner-ruling

246	### Executive
247	
248	**Executive** is the profile label for the frame that selects or confirms the
249	bounded activation configuration and consumes closed Worker and Reviewer
250	results under existing project decision authority. It holds the complete
251	Product view and current MVP or release mandate needed to assign priority,
252	apply disposition, and select the next authorized action.
253	
254	It may be occupied by direct human authority or by a bounded proxy admitted
255	under `STDO-UP-020`, `IDENTITY_METHOD.md`, and the current project authority.
256	It is not a universal semantic owner, controller, manager service, or runtime
257	executive observer.
258	
259	---
260	
261	## Executive Attention, Evaluation, And Action
262	
263	Executive is the profile frame for three inseparable duties over one governed
264	outcome:
265	
266	1. **attention management** maintains the exact outcome and basis, Product-role
267	   map, evaluation inventory, dependency relation, unresolved frontier, actor
268	   envelopes, current MVP or release mandate, applicable triage policy, and
269	   residual boundary, then selects the smallest
270	   dependency-ready activation set sufficient for the next decision within the
271	   finite actor envelopes;
272	2. **evaluation orchestration** activates capable Workers, Reviewers, or
273	   specialists, preserves their exact subjects and bases, and consumes only
274	   closed results or declared translations; and
275	3. **authorized action selection** assigns priority, determines the effect on
276	   the current promotion boundary, applies an existing disposition, and issues
277	   only the next already-authorized activation or action.
278	
279	Executive does not contain the complete workspace, perform every evaluation,
280	or acquire Product meaning, implementation, mutation, acceptance, publication,
281	or other operation authority from the role. A material effect remains owned by
282	the actor carrying its exact operation grant.
283	
284	An actor occupying Executive must not modify candidate, Product or worktree
285	bytes or perform an implementation effect. Filesystem or tool access and an
286	edit being small, test-only, reversible or apparently obvious supply no
287	exception. Mutation requires a separately activated Worker or Writer relation
288	with the exact operation grant, subject and write territory. A same-actor role
289	transition is explicit and recorded in the existing work carrier before the
290	effect; the actor is no longer acting as Executive for that effect. Recording
291	or delegating after an Executive edit cannot authorize it retroactively.
292	
293	The attention cycle is:
294	
295	```text
296	U0 = every known material evaluation not closed on the current basis
297	
298	while U is non-empty:
299	  select a finite dependency-ready subset M that fits the assigned actors
300	  activate each member of M against the exact outcome and basis
301	  keep assurance-independent evaluations free of unclosed peer results
302	  when no other authorized decision is ready:
303	    await decision-relevant input under Event-Driven Executive Attention
304	  record every closed result, technical triage, residual, and invalidation condition
305	  apply only declared conjunctions or translations
306	  assign priority and boundary effect only under the current Product mandate
307	  invalidate affected results when the subject or basis changes
308	  update U from coverage, dependencies, conflicts, and discovered materiality
309	
310	stop only when every mandatory evaluation is closed, or governing authority
311	has explicitly retained every remaining residual consistently with the claim
312	```
313	
314	This relation requires no scheduler or frame engine. `M` may contain parallel
315	activations. Recursion follows declared evaluation dependencies and bounded
316	refinements; it does not nest or join undifferentiated copies of every frame.
317	The Executive retains the frontier and closed-result ledger in attention, not
318	the undocumented working context of every evaluator.
319	
320	Severity supplied by Reviewer is evaluation evidence. Priority, current-boundary
321	effect, `STDO-UP-020` disposition, and subsequent action are Executive decisions.
322	They remain distinct ledger entries even when a Product-defined policy maps one
323	to another.
324	
325	Every result returns to Executive, a declared conjunction, or another frame
326	through an explicit `D` relation. No lateral handoff, child completion, model
327	response, tool output, or shared actor implicitly activates another frame or
328	authorizes continuation. A consumer receives the closed result and its source
329	routes, not the child's hidden reasoning context.
330	
331	### Event-Driven Executive Attention
332	
333	Executive attention is event-driven by default. Re-enter the attention cycle
334	for a decision-relevant closed result, material exception or changed basis,
335	owner request, or declared deadline or checkpoint. While Workers carry out
336	their bounded grants and no other authorized decision is ready, wait. Do not
337	repeatedly inspect unfinished work, replay unchanged judgments, or request
338	status without a decision need.
339	
340	Retain the frontier, return conditions, and valid evidence and judgments.
341	Refresh affected support when a material observation changes its basis;
342	revalidate the [Executive drift locks](#executive-drift-locks) before activation
343	and disposition. Waiting does not waive current-workspace verification,
344	evidence validity, required independent assessment, closed-result consumption,
345	or any authority and closure duty.
346	
347	When notification is unavailable or unreliable, or an actual supervision
348	obligation requires observation, use bounded fallback observation with a
349	declared purpose, cadence or checkpoint, evidence target, and stop or escalation
350	condition. Silence proves neither progress nor failure. Investigate a genuine
351	blocker or material risk and intervene when required, within existing grants;
352	unknown status alone does not establish a stalled Worker.
353	
354	Repeated no-progress observations or returns without new decision-relevant
355	evidence require a bounded reassessment of the frame, grant, dependency or
356	evidence gap and a decision under existing authority. Do not continue polling
357	or repeat the same repair on an unchanged basis. Reduced reasoning churn is
358	not a lower-assurance path or permission to reduce required actor capability;
359	it introduces no universal cost, budget or accounting gate.
360	
361	### Executive Drift Locks
362	
363	Before activation and before disposition, Executive revalidates:
364	
365	- **outcome lock** — selected Goal, Product outcome, boundary, and lawful
366	  re-entry class, current MVP or release mandate, and triage policy remain
367	  unchanged;
368	- **basis lock** — subject, authority, dependency, configuration, topology,
369	  evidence, time, and candidate coordinates remain exact and current;
370	- **Product-role lock** — mutable Source Project, Product Definition,
371	  Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact, and dependent Product identities
372	  remain distinct, and every Development Product role remains bound to its
373	  exact underlying Install;
374	- **authority lock** — semantic, evaluation, operation, decision, acceptance,
375	  and publication owners and grants remain unchanged; and
376	- **coverage-and-return lock** — every material evaluation and interaction is
377	  closed or explicit residual, and every consumed result followed its declared
378	  return relation.
379	
380	Changed Product meaning requires re-entry. A stale or substituted basis is
381	`invalid_basis`. Missing material scope is `out_of_frame`. Missing operation
382	authority refuses activation or the effect. An unresolved mandatory conflict
383	prevents a satisfied conjunction. Executive does not repair any of these by
384	making its own frame larger.
385	
386	### Product-Chain Basis
387	
388	A governed outcome may concern one Product or an explicit directed chain of
389	Products. Its basis records the distinct role of every mutable Source Project,
390	current Product Definition, exact candidate checkpoint, Release Cut, Product,
391	Install, Artifact, Development Product, dependent Product, and composition
392	edge. Each Development Product role binds one exact underlying Install
393	identity. Each edge names its source and target roles, governing authority and
394	contracts, lifecycle, evidence boundary, refusal, and invalidation.
395	
396	An installed Product may lawfully build its own successor or another Product.
397	That Development Product remains distinct from the mutable Source Project and
398	the Product being authored. Directory nesting, shared code, shared actors,
399	source imports, tool reachability, matching labels, or output equality creates
400	no Product identity, composition edge, or authority transfer.
401	
402	Exact basis does not make a Source Project immutable. A Worker may
403	cumulatively mutate the exact Source Project and write territory named by its
404	operation grant. A Reviewer evaluates an exact candidate checkpoint produced
405	from that workspace. Repair advances the workspace, creates a new candidate,
406	and invalidates affected results. A released Product, Release Cut, or exact
407	Install remains immutable under its own lifecycle law; it does not impose
408	immutability on the Source Project constructing a successor.
409	
410	### Worker
411	
412	**Worker** is the profile label for `STDO-UP-020`'s bounded constructor role
413	when activated as a reference frame. It owns construction and self-review
414	inside its exact intake through the operation authority inherited from the
415	governing work relation. It does not acquire admission, publication, acceptance,
416	or continuation authority.
417	
418	### Reviewer
419	
420	**Reviewer** is the profile label for the independent live-surface evaluation
421	consumed by the `STDO-UP-020` assessment relation and governed by
422	`STDO-UP-007` and `STDO-UP-022` when activated as a reference frame. It
423	evaluates one exact subject and returns a closed result with evidence-bound
424	technical triage when a finding exists. It does not implement the repair,
425	assign priority, apply disposition, or activate the next frame.
426	
427	### Technical triage, severity, priority, and boundary effect
428	
429	**Technical triage** is the Reviewer-owned assessment of one finding against
430	the exact evaluated claim and basis. Where supported by admissible evidence and
431	the actor capability envelope, it records:
432	
433	- the affected claim and observed failure;
434	- severity under the Product-selected severity scale;
435	- causal assessment and confidence;
436	- blast radius and affected users, paths, or relations;
437	- available workaround or containment;
438	- repair complexity, regression risk, and material dependencies; and
439	- residual uncertainty and the evidence required to reduce it.
440	
441	Missing causal or repair evidence remains explicit. Reviewer returns
442	`indeterminate` or `out_of_frame` pressure where the missing relation can change
443	the evaluation; it does not invent precision or send work laterally to Worker.
444	
445	**Severity** grades consequence if the finding manifests. **Priority** orders
446	response relative to the complete Product outcome, likelihood and exposure,
447	current MVP or release mandate, reversibility, dependencies, cost of delay, and
448	available capacity. Reviewer grades severity. Executive assigns priority.
449	
450	The Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis binds the severity scale,
451	priority scale, current-boundary decision cutoff, and non-waivable hard stops.
452	This profile imposes no universal numeric scale. Severity, priority, Reference
453	Frame Method result, and current-boundary effect remain distinct. None alone
454	makes a finding release-blocking.
455	
456	**Current-boundary effect** is Executive's determination that the finding blocks
457	the current promotion boundary, requires narrowing, or may remain an explicit
458	residual. Executive then applies exactly one existing `STDO-UP-020`
459	disposition. A hard stop or falsified mandatory claim cannot be waived by
460	lowering priority. An observation outside the exact claim boundary cannot
461	create another review round merely by receiving a severe label.
462	
463	### Work result
464	
465	A **work result** is the closed Worker output to its declared consumer; in the
466	coordinated branch that consumer is Executive. It exists only after successful
467	Worker activation. An `activation_refusal` returns to the assigning authority
468	or declared result carrier and creates neither a Worker activation nor a
469	Worker result.
470	
471	The work-result variants are profile carriers, not new STDO semantic
472	dispositions. They are disjoint by their accompanying Reference Frame Method
473	result:
474	
475	- `candidate_ready` accompanies `satisfied`: an exact candidate and transition
476	  evidence are available;
477	- `refused` accompanies `falsified`: lawful activation occurred, but a
478	  governing prohibition or owner-valid construction refusal defeats the
479	  requested construction;
480	- `incomplete` accompanies `indeterminate`: the valid activation has not
481	  produced a candidate because admissible evidence or bounded execution cannot
482	  yet decide or complete the relation; and
483	- `re_entry_requested` accompanies `out_of_frame` or `invalid_basis`: a
484	  material decision lies outside Worker authority or the activated basis can no
485	  longer support the work.
486	
487	The mapping is total and exclusive after lawful activation. Payload wording,
488	stop timing, or actor preference cannot select another variant. A capability,
489	authority, stale-basis, ambiguous-basis, or topology mismatch known during
490	activation is an `activation_refusal`, not a synthetic Worker result.
491	
492	Consumers choose the representation. `STDO-UP-020` remains the owner of the
493	execution relation and its semantic dispositions.
494	
495	The result references current computed classification, supporting evidence,
496	residual judgments and original rulings through their existing owning carriers.
497	It does not reconstruct unchanged C/J/O for each handoff. The consumer checks
498	applicability and concrete invalidators; changed evidence revises only affected
499	results, preserving originals and supported surviving claims under
500	`TICKET_METHOD.md#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity`.
501	
502	### Exact candidate
503	
504	An **exact candidate** is the subject identity required by `STDO-UP-020`
505	transition evidence and `STDO-UP-007` review traceability. Where
506	`STDO-UP-022` generic method qualification applies, its construction result is
507	frozen before material reference exposure as that clause requires. Elsewhere,
508	this profile stabilizes the review subject through an immutable identity or an
509	equivalent exact-subject relation sufficient for the claimed assessment.
510	
511	This profile does not create a new constitutional lifecycle state named
512	`frozen`.
513	
514	### Baseline-adoption projection
515	
516	A **baseline-adoption projection** consumes the Product-owned Project
517	Reference-Frame Basis defined by
518	`SPEC_METHOD.md#collective-reference-frame-basis`. Where that basis adopts this
519	profile, the projection records the selected profile mapping, exact outcome,
520	actor envelopes, evidence coordinates, and revision conditions needed in
521	addition to the Product binding. It is not a second frame-basis definition and
522	does not mint the authority it projects.
523	
524	---
525	
526	## Non-Hierarchical Frame Configuration
527	
528	The active configuration uses three distinct relation structures:
529	
530	1. **authority precedence** determines which existing surface may select work,

   only the next already-authorized activation or action.

Executive does not contain the complete workspace, perform every evaluation,
or acquire Product meaning, implementation, mutation, acceptance, publication,
or other operation authority from the role. A material effect remains owned by
the actor carrying its exact operation grant.

An actor occupying Executive must not modify candidate, Product or worktree
bytes or perform an implementation effect. Filesystem or tool access and an
edit being small, test-only, reversible or apparently obvious supply no
exception. Mutation requires a separately activated Worker or Writer relation
with the exact operation grant, subject and write territory. A same-actor role
transition is explicit and recorded in the existing work carrier before the
effect; the actor is no longer acting as Executive for that effect. Recording
or delegating after an Executive edit cannot authorize it retroactively.

The attention cycle is:

```text
U0 = every known material evaluation not closed on the current basis

while U is non-empty:
  select a finite dependency-ready subset M that fits the assigned actors
  activate each member of M against the exact outcome and basis
  keep assurance-independent evaluations free of unclosed peer results
  when no other authorized decision is ready:
    await decision-relevant input under Event-Driven Executive Attention
  record every closed result, technical triage, residual, and invalidation condition
  apply only declared conjunctions or translations
  assign priority and boundary effect only under the current Product mandate
  invalidate affected results when the subject or basis changes
  update U from coverage, dependencies, conflicts, and discovered materiality

stop only when every mandatory evaluation is closed, or governing authority
has explicitly retained every remaining residual consistently with the claim
```

This relation requires no scheduler or frame engine. `M` may contain parallel
activations. Recursion follows declared evaluation dependencies and bounded
refinements; it does not nest or join undifferentiated copies of every frame.
The Executive retains the frontier and closed-result ledger in attention, not
the undocumented working context of every evaluator.

Severity supplied by Reviewer is evaluation evidence. Priority, current-boundary
effect, `STDO-UP-020` disposition, and subsequent action are Executive decisions.
They remain distinct ledger entries even when a Product-defined policy maps one
to another.

Every result returns to Executive, a declared conjunction, or another frame
through an explicit `D` relation. No lateral handoff, child completion, model
response, tool output, or shared actor implicitly activates another frame or
authorizes continuation. A consumer receives the closed result and its source
routes, not the child's hidden reasoning context.

### Event-Driven Executive Attention

Executive attention is event-driven by default. Re-enter the attention cycle
for a decision-relevant closed result, material exception or changed basis,
owner request, or declared deadline or checkpoint. While Workers carry out
their bounded grants and no other authorized decision is ready, wait. Do not
repeatedly inspect unfinished work, replay unchanged judgments, or request
status without a decision need.

Retain the frontier, return conditions, and valid evidence and judgments.
Refresh affected support when a material observation changes its basis;
revalidate the [Executive drift locks](#executive-drift-locks) before activation
and disposition. Waiting does not waive current-workspace verification,
evidence validity, required independent assessment, closed-result consumption,
or any authority and closure duty.

When notification is unavailable or unreliable, or an actual supervision
obligation requires observation, use bounded fallback observation with a
declared purpose, cadence or checkpoint, evidence target, and stop or escalation
condition. Silence proves neither progress nor failure. Investigate a genuine
blocker or material risk and intervene when required, within existing grants;
unknown status alone does not establish a stalled Worker.

Repeated no-progress observations or returns without new decision-relevant
evidence require a bounded reassessment of the frame, grant, dependency or
evidence gap and a decision under existing authority. Do not continue polling
or repeat the same repair on an unchanged basis. Reduced reasoning churn is
not a lower-assurance path or permission to reduce required actor capability;
it introduces no universal cost, budget or accounting gate.

### Executive Drift Locks

Before activation and before disposition, Executive revalidates:

- **outcome lock** — selected Goal, Product outcome, boundary, and lawful
  re-entry class, current MVP or release mandate, and triage policy remain
  unchanged;
- **basis lock** — subject, authority, dependency, configuration, topology,
  evidence, time, and candidate coordinates remain exact and current;
- **Product-role lock** — mutable Source Project, Product Definition,
  Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact, and dependent Product identities
  remain distinct, and every Development Product role remains bound to its
  exact underlying Install;
- **authority lock** — semantic, evaluation, operation, decision, acceptance,
  and publication owners and grants remain unchanged; and
- **coverage-and-return lock** — every material evaluation and interaction is
  closed or explicit residual, and every consumed result followed its declared
  return relation.

Changed Product meaning requires re-entry. A stale or substituted basis is
`invalid_basis`. Missing material scope is `out_of_frame`. Missing operation
authority refuses activation or the effect. An unresolved mandatory conflict
prevents a satisfied conjunction. Executive does not repair any of these by
making its own frame larger.

### Product-Chain Basis

A governed outcome may concern one Product or an explicit directed chain of
Products. Its basis records the distinct role of every mutable Source Project,
current Product Definition, exact candidate checkpoint, Release Cut, Product,
Install, Artifact, Development Product, dependent Product, and composition
edge. Each Development Product role binds one exact underlying Install
identity. Each edge names its source and target roles, governing authority and
contracts, lifecycle, evidence boundary, refusal, and invalidation.

An installed Product may lawfully build its own successor or another Product.
That Development Product remains distinct from the mutable Source Project and
the Product being authored. Directory nesting, shared code, shared actors,
source imports, tool reachability, matching labels, or output equality creates
no Product identity, composition edge, or authority transfer.

Exact basis does not make a Source Project immutable. A Worker may
cumulatively mutate the exact Source Project and write territory named by its
operation grant. A Reviewer evaluates an exact candidate checkpoint produced
from that workspace. Repair advances the workspace, creates a new candidate,
and invalidates affected results. A released Product, Release Cut, or exact
Install remains immutable under its own lifecycle law; it does not impose
immutability on the Source Project constructing a successor.

### Worker

**Worker** is the profile label for `STDO-UP-020`'s bounded constructor role
when activated as a reference frame. It owns construction and self-review
inside its exact intake through the operation authority inherited from the
governing work relation. It does not acquire admission, publication, acceptance,
or continuation authority.

### Reviewer

**Reviewer** is the profile label for the independent live-surface evaluation
consumed by the `STDO-UP-020` assessment relation and governed by
`STDO-UP-007` and `STDO-UP-022` when activated as a reference frame. It
evaluates one exact subject and returns a closed result with evidence-bound
technical triage when a finding exists. It does not implement the repair,
assign priority, apply disposition, or activate the next frame.

### Technical triage, severity, priority, and boundary effect

**Technical triage** is the Reviewer-owned assessment of one finding against
the exact evaluated claim and basis. Where supported by admissible evidence and
the actor capability envelope, it records:

- the affected claim and observed failure;
- severity under the Product-selected severity scale;
- causal assessment and confidence;
- blast radius and affected users, paths, or relations;
- available workaround or containment;
- repair complexity, regression risk, and material dependencies; and
- residual uncertainty and the evidence required to reduce it.

Missing causal or repair evidence remains explicit. Reviewer returns
`indeterminate` or `out_of_frame` pressure where the missing relation can change
the evaluation; it does not invent precision or send work laterally to Worker.

**Severity** grades consequence if the finding manifests. **Priority** orders
response relative to the complete Product outcome, likelihood and exposure,
current MVP or release mandate, reversibility, dependencies, cost of delay, and
available capacity. Reviewer grades severity. Executive assigns priority.

The Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis binds the severity scale,
priority scale, current-boundary decision cutoff, and non-waivable hard stops.
This profile imposes no universal numeric scale. Severity, priority, Reference
Frame Method result, and current-boundary effect remain distinct. None alone
makes a finding release-blocking.

**Current-boundary effect** is Executive's determination that the finding blocks
the current promotion boundary, requires narrowing, or may remain an explicit
residual. Executive then applies exactly one existing `STDO-UP-020`
disposition. A hard stop or falsified mandatory claim cannot be waived by
lowering priority. An observation outside the exact claim boundary cannot
create another review round merely by receiving a severe label.

### Work result

A **work result** is the closed Worker output to its declared consumer; in the
coordinated branch that consumer is Executive. It exists only after successful
Worker activation. An `activation_refusal` returns to the assigning authority
or declared result carrier and creates neither a Worker activation nor a
Worker result.

The work-result variants are profile carriers, not new STDO semantic
dispositions. They are disjoint by their accompanying Reference Frame Method
result:

- `candidate_ready` accompanies `satisfied`: an exact candidate and transition
  evidence are available;
- `refused` accompanies `falsified`: lawful activation occurred, but a
  governing prohibition or owner-valid construction refusal defeats the
  requested construction;
- `incomplete` accompanies `indeterminate`: the valid activation has not
  produced a candidate because admissible evidence or bounded execution cannot
  yet decide or complete the relation; and
- `re_entry_requested` accompanies `out_of_frame` or `invalid_basis`: a
  material decision lies outside Worker authority or the activated basis can no
  longer support the work.

The mapping is total and exclusive after lawful activation. Payload wording,
stop timing, or actor preference cannot select another variant. A capability,
authority, stale-basis, ambiguous-basis, or topology mismatch known during
activation is an `activation_refusal`, not a synthetic Worker result.

Consumers choose the representation. `STDO-UP-020` remains the owner of the
execution relation and its semantic dispositions.

The result references current computed classification, supporting evidence,
residual judgments and original rulings through their existing owning carriers.
It does not reconstruct unchanged C/J/O for each handoff. The consumer checks
applicability and concrete invalidators; changed evidence revises only affected
results, preserving originals and supported surviving claims under
`TICKET_METHOD.md#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity`.

### Exact candidate

An **exact candidate** is the subject identity required by `STDO-UP-020`
transition evidence and `STDO-UP-007` review traceability. Where
`STDO-UP-022` generic method qualification applies, its construction result is
frozen before material reference exposure as that clause requires. Elsewhere,
this profile stabilizes the review subject through an immutable identity or an
equivalent exact-subject relation sufficient for the claimed assessment.

This profile does not create a new constitutional lifecycle state named
`frozen`.

### Baseline-adoption projection

A **baseline-adoption projection** consumes the Product-owned Project
Reference-Frame Basis defined by
`SPEC_METHOD.md#collective-reference-frame-basis`. Where that basis adopts this
profile, the projection records the selected profile mapping, exact outcome,
actor envelopes, evidence coordinates, and revision conditions needed in
addition to the Product binding. It is not a second frame-basis definition and
does not mint the authority it projects.
